name: What steps are involved in a multi-room remodeling project with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a multi-room remodeling project with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our multi-room remodeling process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and needs. This is followed by detailed design planning, where we create layouts and select materials. Once designs are approved and permits secured, we proceed with construction, managing all trades and ensuring quality craftsmanship. The project concludes with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction. Throughout, we maintain open communication.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design planning, permitting, construction, and a final walkthrough, with continuous communication.
